initial_requirements: Owners and users of a computing cluster need a scheduler that allocates processing resources according to user-oriented quality-of-service goals. Libra will receive submitted batch jobs from an existing cluster management system and schedule them using information such as each user's budget and deadline. It should select suitable execution resources and enforce the resulting allocation while the surrounding platform remains responsible for receiving and dispatching jobs.
